records.translation: {count} auðkenni fyrir (brunn, gRNA) hafa fleiri en eitt gildi fyrir 'fraction', svo hlutfall gensins í brunninum er tvírætt; til dæmis {example}. records.key: automatic horseshoe calibration needs at least two identified predictors; provide expected_hits strictly between zero and the identified count or an explicit scale_global
records.source: automatic horseshoe calibration needs at least two identified predictors; provide expected_hits strictly between zero and the identified count or an explicit scale_global
records.translation: sjálfvirk horseshoe-kvörðun krefst að minnsta kosti tveggja auðkennanlegra skýribreyta; tilgreinið expected_hits stranglega á milli núlls og fjölda auðkennanlegra skýribreyta eða skýrt gildi fyrir scale_global

records.key: automatic weighted calibration needs aligned likelihood_well_ids; arbitrary weights require an explicit scale_global
records.source: automatic weighted calibration needs aligned likelihood_well_ids; arbitrary weights require an explicit scale_global
records.translation: sjálfvirk vigtuð kvörðun krefst likelihood_well_ids í sömu röð og línurnar; handahófskennd vægi krefjast skýrs gildis fyrir scale_global

records.key: independent-well calibration requires exact inverse row-multiplicity weights
records.source: independent-well calibration requires exact inverse row-multiplicity weights
records.translation: kvörðun óháðra brunna krefst nákvæmra vægja sem eru andhverfa fjölda endurtekinna lína

records.key: likelihood_weights must be a positive finite vector aligned with design rows
records.source: likelihood_weights must be a positive finite vector aligned with design rows
records.translation: likelihood_weights verður að vera jákvæður endanlegur vigur í sömu röð og línur hönnunarfylkisins

records.key: likelihood_well_ids must align with every design row
records.source: likelihood_well_ids must align with every design row
records.translation: likelihood_well_ids verður að samsvara hverri línu hönnunarfylkisins

records.key: likelihood_well_ids must be hashable physical-well identities
records.source: likelihood_well_ids must be hashable physical-well identities
records.translation: likelihood_well_ids verða að vera hakkhæf auðkenni efnislegra brunna
likelihood_well_ids krefst fullkominna auðkenna efnislegra brunna

records.key: no identified nonconstant predictor remains for horseshoe calibration
records.source: no identified nonconstant predictor remains for horseshoe calibration
records.translation: engin auðkennanleg skýribreyta sem er ekki föst er eftir fyrir horseshoe-kvörðun

records.key: one likelihood_well_ids identity must have identical design, counts and exposure

records.translation: eitt likelihood_well_ids-auðkenni verður að hafa eins hönnunargildi, talningar og útsetningu
